text:
(1) Hives (small, itchy, red bumps), some in circular patterns, mostly occurred on ears, neck, fingers and arms, and a few scattered around rest of body.
(2) Pain on right foot, started with ball of foot and in a few days encompassed entire foot.
The only good thing I noticed was I didn't seem as bloated in my stomach while taking it, but that was not the reason for it being prescribed.
The reason was to try to treat a pain in my lower right rib, which was not affected by the medicine.
